blocks.prompt: 8. Use Trapezoidal Rule to approximate the value of the definite integral \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \sin(x^{2})\,dx\) taking \(h = \frac{\pi}{6}\).
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke yeh kis qisam ka sawal hai: definite integral ki value Trapezium Rule se approximately nikalni hai, seedha integration nahi karna.
Diya kya hai? Function \(f(x) = \sin(x^{2})\), interval \([0, \pi]\), aur \(h = \frac{\pi}{6}\) diya hai, to pehle \(n = \frac{b-a}{h}\) nikalna hoga.
Find kya karna hai? Integral ki approximate value, chaar decimal places tak.
Rule kaunsa aur kyun? Trapezium Rule, kyunke sawal yahi maangta hai: area ko barabar chaurai ki pattiyon (trapeziums) mein baant kar jama karna.
Plan: h ya n, phir points ki list, phir har point par function ki value, phir beech wali values ka jama, aur aakhir mein formula aur tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sin(x^{2})\), \(a = 0\), \(b = \pi\), \(h = \frac{\pi}{6}\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \sin(x^{2})\,dx\) ki approximate value.
Tareeqa: sawal khud Trapezium Rule maang raha hai, is liye wohi lagayenge. Yahan \(n\) nahi balke \(h = \frac{\pi}{6}\) diya hai, is liye pehle \(n = \frac{b-a}{h}\) nikalenge. Phir points aur un par function ki values (chaar decimal tak) nikal kar formula \(\frac{h}{2}[\text{pehli} + 2(\text{beech wali}) + \text{aakhri}]\) mein rakhenge.

Continuity
\(\sin(x^{2})\) mein andar \(x^{2}\) (polynomial) aur bahar \(\sin\) hai; dono har jagah continuous hain, is liye composition bhi \([0, \pi]\) par continuous hai.
Kyun: Trapezium Rule continuous function ke liye bana hai; agar graph beech mein toot jaye to trapeziums us hisse ko sahi nahi dhaanp sakte.

Subintervals ki tadaad aur points
\[n = \dfrac{b-a}{h} = \dfrac{\pi - 0}{\pi/6} = 6\]
Points \(x_{i} = a + ih\): \(0, \tfrac{\pi}{6}, \tfrac{\pi}{3}, \tfrac{\pi}{2}, \tfrac{2\pi}{3}, \tfrac{5\pi}{6}, \pi\)
Kyun: \(h = \frac{b-a}{n}\) ko ulat kar \(n = \frac{b-a}{h}\) milta hai, yani poori lambai mein \(h\) kitni dafa aata hai. 6 subintervals ke 7 points hain; har agla point pichle se \(h\) aage hai.

Function values (4 decimal places)
\[x_{i}^{2}:\ 0,\ 0.274156,\ 1.096623,\]
\[2.467401,\ 4.386491,\]
\[6.853892,\ 9.869604\]
\[f(0) = \sin(0.000000) = 0.0000\]
\[f(\tfrac{\pi}{6}) = \sin(0.274156) = 0.2707\]
\[f(\tfrac{\pi}{3}) = \sin(1.096623) = 0.8897\]
\[f(\tfrac{\pi}{2}) = \sin(2.467401) = 0.6243\]
\[f(\tfrac{2\pi}{3}) = \sin(4.386491) = -0.9474\]
\[f(\tfrac{5\pi}{6}) = \sin(6.853892) = 0.5402\]
\[f(\pi) = \sin(9.869604) = -0.4303\]
Kyun: har point ko function mein rakha. Pehle \(x_{i}\) ka square karein (yeh radians mein number hai), phir radian mode mein sine lein. \(\sin(x^{2})\) aur \((\sin x)^{2}\) alag cheezein hain: misaal ke taur par \(x = \frac{\pi}{3}\) par \(\sin(1.0966) = 0.8897\), jab ke \((\sin\frac{\pi}{3})^{2} = 0.75\).
Dhyan dein: \(f(\frac{2\pi}{3})\) aur \(f(\pi)\) negative hain; in ke minus sign saath rakhein (Note 3: signed area).
Neeche jawab ke saath di gayi table mein yahi values un ke weights (1 ya 2) ke saath hain.

Beech wali values jama karein
\[S = f(x_{1}) + \dots + f(x_{5})\]
\[= 0.2707 + 0.8897 + 0.6243\]
\[- 0.9474 + 0.5402\]
\[= 1.3775\]
Kyun: yeh 5 beech wali values har ek do saath wale trapeziums ki saanjhi deewar hain, is liye formula mein in ka jama do dafa (double) aayega. Pehle in ka jama alag nikal lena hisaab ko saaf aur check karne ke qabil banata hai.

Trapezium Rule apply karein
\[\int_{0}^{\pi} \sin(x^{2})\,dx\]
\[\approx \dfrac{h}{2}\big[f(x_{0}) + 2S + f(x_{6})\big]\]
\[= \dfrac{\pi}{12}\big[0 + 2(1.3775) + (-0.4303)\big]\]
\[= \dfrac{\pi}{12}(2.3247)\]
\[= 0.261799 \times 2.3247 = 0.6086\]
Kyun: \(\frac{h}{2} = \frac{\pi}{12} \approx 0.261799\). Kinaron wali do values ek ek dafa aayin aur beech wali values ka jama do dafa; phir poore bracket ko \(\frac{h}{2}\) se zarb diya. Round sirf aakhri jawab ko kiya, beech mein nahi, taake ghalti jama na ho.

Tasdeeq:
\(\sin(x^{2})\) ka bhi koi elementary antiderivative nahi (8.4 ke shuru mein kitab ne isi integral ki misaal di thi). Computer bohat zyada subintervals le kar 0.7727 deta hai, yani 6 pattiyon ke saath ghalti kaafi bari hai (taqreeban 0.16). Wajah: \(x\) jab 0 se \(\pi\) tak jata hai to \(x^{2}\) 0 se 9.87 radians tak jata hai, is liye graph tezi se upar neeche lehrata hai aur sirf 6 seedhi lakeerein us ka peecha nahi kar saktin. Behtar jawab ke liye bohat chhota h chahiye. Phir bhi sawal ne \(h = \frac{\pi}{6}\) maanga hai, is liye exam mein jawab 0.6086 hi likhna hai; yeh tabsira sirf samajhne ke liye hai ke numerical method ka jawab kab kamzor hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key 0.6179 likhti hai. Har value dobara nikalne par bracket \(2.3247\) aata hai aur \(\frac{\pi}{12}(2.3247) = 0.6086\) (poori values ke saath bhi 0.6086). Sahi jawab 0.6086 hai.
